title: EventInviteUserRequest
description: Publish an event that indicates a person would like to invite a user to an organization.

id.description: The unique ID for this event.

invite_id.description: The unique identifier for this specific invite to correlate messages against.

entity.description: The entity that the invite is sent to.

requesting_user_id.description: The user who originally requested this invite.

requesting_user_email.description: The user who originally requested this invite.

email.description: The email address of the user to invite.

creation_date.description: The date of birth for this person

roles.description: The roles that this user will be given when invited.
